name: Test Python Runtime

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'python/**'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'uv.lock'
      - '.github/workflows/release-python-runtime.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/test-python-runtime.yml'

env:
  UV_PYTHON_PREFERENCE: managed

jobs:
  test-python-runtime:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ['3.9', '3.10', '3.11', '3.12']
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@eac588ad8def6316056a12d4907a9d4d84ff7a3b # v7.3.0
        with:
          version: '0.9.22'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          uv pip install --system --no-deps python/vercel-runtime
          uv pip install --system pytest pytest-asyncio

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          cd python/vercel-runtime
          python -m pytest tests/ -v

      - name: Test installation
        run: |
          cd python/vercel-runtime
          python -c "import vercel_runtime; print('Import successful')"
          python -c "import vercel_runtime; print(vercel_runtime.__version__)"
